CHECK THE WIPER LINKAGE

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Turn off the instrument panel and check the linkage moves correctly, in particular:

  • check the linkage does not interfere with the body and is not impeded by foreign bodies present in the wiper housing;
  • check the wiper unit has been correctly assembled.

End of diagnosis

1. The linkage interferes with the body.

1. Restore the correct operation of the linkage.

2. Foreign bodies present in the wiper housing.

2. Remove the foreign bodies from the wiper.

3. Incorrect wiper fastening.

3. Replace the wiper unit
